newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia police officer charged with rape.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia police officer charged with rape.

text.p: A Philadelphia policeman was arrested and charged with the rape of a teenage girl he allegedly enticed into his apartment to take photographs, police said Sunday.
Carlos Alvarez, 34, is charged with sexual assault, corrupting a minor and lesser charges. He was off duty when the alleged incident occurred.

According to police, Alvarez raped the unidentified girl in his apartment Friday after he persuaded her to visit for a photo session. The girl reported the incident to police immediately after she left the apartment.
